checks.claim: Roofing underlayment is a water-resistant sheet laid over the roof deck under the shingles.
checks.why: Manufacturers and the asphalt roofing trade group describe underlayment as the water-resistant layer installed on the deck before the shingles.

sources.title: How roofing underlayment helps protect your home (Owens Corning)
ARMA Technical Bulletin: Use of Asphalt Shingle Underlayment

checks.claim: Shingle rows overlap so each row covers the joints of the row below.
checks.why: Courses are offset at least 4 inches so joints never line up and water has no direct path to the underlayment.

checks.claim: Chimney flashing is bent metal that seals the joint where the chimney meets the roof.
checks.why: L-shaped step flashing woven into the shingles and counterflashing set in the brick seal the roof-to-chimney joint.

sources.title: From the Roof Down: Flashing (National Park Service)

checks.claim: Downspouts should carry roof water several feet away from the foundation.
checks.why: Guidance ranges from 4 to 10 feet; 5 feet is the common minimum for surface discharge.

sources.title: Is Your Downspout Too Short? (Bob Vila)
What Is Downspout Disconnection? (City of Portland)
